listing.summary: Adds the phase shunt hullmod that works similar to shield shunt except with a different S-mod bonus, reduced CR to deploy. There is a settings file to modify the values. It is part of base hullmods so you won't have to discover it.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hullmod similar to Shield Shunt but with a different S-mod bonus and reduced deployment cost.

description:
Adds the phase shunt hullmod that works similar to shield shunt except with a different S-mod bonus, reduced CR to deploy. There is a settings file to modify the values. It is part of base hullmods so you won't have to discover it.

You can set it to a percentage or flat bonus for armor bonus. The S-mod bonus is also able to be modified.

No known incompatibilities, the AI tweaks issue was fixed in an AI tweaks update.

It should be unavailable to NPCs, so if is not installed on any ships you should be able to disable the mod mid-save.

Download:
https://gitlab.com/starsector/phase_shunt/-/archive/0.0.5/phase_shunt-0.0.5.zip

Previous versions:
https://gitlab.com/starsector/phase_shunt/-/releases
